description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a frame‑gridmesh structural block containing meshed grid–frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::FRAMEGRIDMESH

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [GRIDMESH-A]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::GM1
    FRAME::INNER

  [GRIDMESH-B]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::GM2
    FRAME::OUTER

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    GRIDMESH-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    GRIDMESH-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-FRAMEGRIDMESH}
  D4-C3-B2-A1

<END-FRAMEGRIDMESH>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire framegridmesh block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
